data.name: CommandSourceInvalid
data.value: A secret source must use parameter:<name> or <resource>:<key> with exactly one resource separator; literal sources are forbidden.

data.name: CommandPathInvalid
data.value: A secret command path must be nonblank and must not be trusted-issuers.json or begin with certs/.

data.name: CertificateNameInvalid
data.value: A certificate name must be one nonblank segment other than '.' or '..' and contain neither slash nor backslash.

data.name: SubjectAlternativeNameInvalid
data.value: A certificate alternative name must be a nonblank IP address or an encodable certificate DNS name.
